title: Resource implementation guidance prefers nested helper composition over custom validator wrappers

provenance.originSummary: Sanitized benchmark derived from accepted maintainer review in hashicorp/terraform-provider-azurerm PR #33023.
provenance.whyItMattered: A maintainer explicitly preferred inline validation.All/validation.Any composition over a custom validator plus unit test; the accepted implementation establishes the placement precedent while genuinely complex bespoke logic remains the validate-package exception.
provenance.genericCondition: Sanitized fixture models the boundary between understandable nested helper composition and genuinely complex custom validation.

description: A sanitized implementation-guidance scenario where one changed field uses understandable nested validation.All/validation.Any composition and another uses genuinely complex anonymous custom parsing. The correct guidance should preserve the established-helper composition inline, extract only the complex bespoke validator into a service-local validate/ file with matching unit coverage, and avoid unrelated legacy cleanup.

scope.notes: Sanitized fixture generalizes an accepted upstream validator-placement precedent.

mustCatch.description: The guidance should move the genuinely complex anonymous custom parser into a subject-specific validator under validate/, with matching unit coverage.

mustNotFlag.description: The guidance must not replace understandable nested validation.All/validation.Any composition with a custom validator wrapper, validate file, or wrapper-only unit test.
The guidance must not leave the bespoke validator inline or place it in an unrelated helper file when the established pattern is a service-local validate/ file with matching tests.
The guidance must not require repo-wide or unrelated cleanup of existing legacy validator placement outside the changed scope just to normalize the layout.

mustHaveSections: minimal set of code changes needed

notes: Use this to preserve the accepted inline-composition precedent while retaining validate files for genuinely complex bespoke validation and avoiding unrelated legacy churn.
